blocks.text: Tajurbati chemistry ke shuru hi se scientists ne acids aur bases ko un ki numayan khusoosiyat se pehchana hai. Acids ka zaiqa khatta (sour) hota hai; bases karwe (bitter). Acids aur bases kuch rangon, jinhen indicators kehte hain, jaise litmus aur phenolphthalein, ka rang bhi badalte hain: acids litmus ko neele se surkh aur phenolphthalein ko gulabi se be-rang karte hain, jabke bases litmus ko surkh se neela aur phenolphthalein ko be-rang se gulabi. Jaisa in rang ki tabdeeliyon se zahir hai, acids aur bases ek doosre ko be-asar (neutralise) karte hain, aur react kar ke ionic madde banate hain jinhen salts kehte hain. Maide ki tezabiyat zyada HCl ki wajah se hoti hai aur baking soda jaise halke bases se ilaj hoti hai.

1923 mein Danish chemist J. N. Bronsted aur English chemist T. M. Lowry ne alag alag Arrhenius theory ko wusat di, jis ki kami yeh hai ke woh acid aur base ka reaction sirf aabi (aqueous) medium mein bayan karti hai, halanke bohat se reactions doosre solvents mein ya kisi solvent ke baghair hote hain. Unhon ne bataya ke acid-base reactions ko proton muntaqil karne (proton transfer) ke reactions ke taur par dekha ja sakta hai, to acids aur bases ki tareef proton (H+) ki muntaqili se ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Bronsted-Lowry acid aur base
blocks.text: Bronsted-Lowry tasawwur ke mutabiq acid woh species hai jo proton-transfer reaction mein proton deti hai aur base woh species jo proton qubool karti hai.

Jab HCl pani mein halta hai to ek proton HCl se pani ko muntaqil hota hai, jahan woh O atom ke lone pair se jur kar H3O+ banata hai: HCl(g) + H2O(l) se H3O+(aq) + Cl-(aq). HCl, proton dene wala, acid hai aur H2O, proton lene wala, base. Bronsted base ke proton qubool karne ke baad banne wali species conjugate acid kehlati hai, to hydronium ion H3O+ pani ka conjugate acid hai; acid ke proton dene par banne wali species conjugate base kehlati hai. HCl / Cl- aur H2O / H3O+ conjugate acid-base jore (pairs) hain.

Jab ammonia pani mein halti hai to bhi proton transfer hota hai: H2O ka ek H+ N atom ke lone pair se jurta hai, NH4+ aur OH- bante hain: NH3(g) + H2O(l) se NH4+(aq) + OH-(aq). Yahan H2O (acid) ne proton diya aur NH3 (base) ne qubool kiya; NH3 / NH4+ aur H2O / OH- conjugate jore hain. Yeh misalein dikhati hain ke pani amphoteric hai, ek soorat mein base aur doosri mein acid: amphoteric madda doosre reactant ke mutabiq acid ya base dono ban sakta hai (proton kho ya pa sakta hai). Yeh theory pani ke ilawa solvents aur be-solvent reactions par bhi lagoo hai: gaseous ammonia aur HCl thos NH4Cl dete hain, HCl NH3 ko proton deta hai, jo hydroxide ion na hone ke bawajood base ka kaam karti hai.

Daen panel: do ammonia molecules Ag+ ko electron pairs de kar diammine silver adduct banate hue, aur F- BF3 ko de kar BF4- banate hue, Lewis base, Lewis acid aur adduct ke labels ke saath. blocks.long_description: Bronsted-Lowry tasweer mein acid base ko proton deta hai: HCl pani ko, H3O+ aur Cl- dete hue, ya pani ammonia ko, NH4+ aur OH- dete hue. Ek proton ke farq wali species ka har jora conjugate pair hai, aur pani pehle reaction mein base aur doosre mein acid hai, jo use amphoteric banata hai. Lewis tasweer mein proton ki zaroorat nahi: base electron pair deta hai, acid qubool karta hai, aur woh pair adduct mein coordinate covalent bond ban jata hai, jis ka charge reactants ke charges ka majmooa hai. Table 9.1 nitric acid, sulfuric acid aur pani ke carbonate ion ke saath conjugate jore deti hai.

blocks.explanation: HCN proton deta hai, to HCN / CN- ek jora aur H2O / H3O+ doosra. Doosre reaction mein HCl HCO3- ko proton deta hai, to HCl / Cl- ek jora aur HCO3- / H2CO3 (base aur us ka conjugate acid) doosra.

items: Acids khatte, bases karwe; indicator ke rang badalte aur ek doosre ko neutralise kar ke salts dete hain. Arrhenius theory sirf pani mein chalti hai.
Bronsted-Lowry (1923): acid = proton dene wala, base = proton lene wala; base + H+ us ka conjugate acid, acid - H+ us ka conjugate base (HCl / Cl-, H2O / H3O+, NH3 / NH4+, H2O / OH-).
Pani amphoteric hai; theory doosre solvents aur be-solvent reactions jaise HCl(g) + NH3(g) se NH4Cl(s) par bhi lagoo hai.
